svg.title: Current finances wireframe
svg.text: Accounts the engine reads for taxes and drawdown.
Row editor: type, balance, owner, cost basis or contributions.
Cost basis is required for taxable accounts
Add account covers savings, taxable, 401(k), Roth 401(k), IRA, Roth IRA, HSA, and 529. One form, type-specific
Mixed owners stay visible per row: You, Partner, or Joint. No owner is inferred.
Cost basis edits persist and feed capital-gains estimates. The row shows Cost or Contributions, never both.
Saving the 401(k) at $511,111 raises the Investments total and net worth by the same amount without a reload.
